lines.t: The road was rough, but the truth cut through,
Like a fire in the dark, making all things new.
I walked crooked lines with a stubborn heart,
Till the Word came down and tore my world apart.
Now I hear that call rollin’ like a thunder sound,
Telling me to stand when the whole world bows down.
Break me wide open, make me right,
Turn these ashes into light.
When the lies come blowin’ through,
I’ll keep my eyes on what is true.
Take these chains and make ’em gone,
Lead me where I belong.
I was lost, but now I’m found,
By the hand that turns it all around.
Every voice tried pullin’ me away,
But mercy met me in the middle of the gray.
What was scattered now is coming clear,
Truth keeps speakin’ loud enough to hear.
And I won’t run from the fire anymore,
I was made for the fight, and I know what it’s for.
Break me wide open, make me right,
Turn these ashes into light.
When the lies come blowin’ through,
I’ll keep my eyes on what is true.
Take these chains and make ’em gone,
Lead me where I belong.
I was lost, but now I’m found,
By the hand that turns it all around.
Set these crooked paths straight,
Let the dead thing live today.
Every broken piece of me
Is a place Your power can reach.
Break me wide open, make me right,
Turn these ashes into light.
When the lies come blowin’ through,
I’ll keep my eyes on what is true.
Take these chains and make ’em gone,
Lead me where I belong.
I was lost, but now I’m found,
By the hand that turns it all around.
